Diagnostic Plots for a Doubly Robust CATE (DR-Learner) Fit

Source: R/cate_and_sim.R
autoplot.tmle_cate.Rd

Visualizes treatment-effect heterogeneity and prioritization uplift for a "tmle_cate" object returned by fit_cate():

  • "qini": Plots the Qini Cumulative Uplift Curve ordering individuals from highest to lowest predicted benefit \(\hat{\tau}(V)\) against the random-targeting diagonal baseline, shading the incremental uplift gain (Qini AUC).

  • "cate": Plots the distribution of out-of-fold predicted CATEs \(\hat{\tau}(V)\) relative to the population Average Treatment Effect, annotating the Chernozhukov et al. (2018) heterogeneity p-value.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tmle_cate'
autoplot(object, type = c("qini", "cate"), ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted "tmle_cate" object.

type

Plot type: "qini" (default) or "cate".

...

Currently unused.

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Examples

df <- sim_causal_cohort(n = 200, outcome_type = "continuous", seed = 42)
fit <- tmle_spec(y, a, c(age, sex, lab_1, lab_2)) |>
  set_resamples(v_folds = 3L) |>
  fit(df)
cate <- fit_cate(fit, v_folds = 3L)
autoplot(cate, type = "qini")

autoplot(cate, type = "cate")
